title: Building AI agents for 131 million customers
summary: Five lessons from putting customer-support agents into production: why evaluation comes first, what transactional NPS actually measures, and how prompt optimization and composite tools behave at scale.

title: Muon for improved foundation model pretraining data efficiency
note: with Daniel Braithwaite, Arissa Yoshida and Rafael Celente

title: GDMix: A deep ranking personalization framework
note: with Jun Shi, Chengming Jiang and others
summary: The open-source framework behind per-member personalization of LinkedIn's ranking models, and how generalized mixed models train at that scale.
